page.overview:
Who is Chalce?

Chalce is an admin of the Explorers, an employee at Exceed, and a major antagonist appearing in .

Chalce is an adult woman who has brown skin and eyes, thick lips, and dark brown hair in large dreadlocks. She wears a long white shirt with dark orange clips, brown and black belts around her waist, a dark orange skirt with dull yellow rims, and white boots with blue accents and yellow buttons. Her dreadlocks are adorned with large, pale beige, and blue trapezoid accessories, and her forehead, neck, and wrists with dark orange rings. She also has three Poké Balls around her hip and a Mega Ring on her right wrist.

Though a calm and collected individual, Chalce will not hesitate to call out her allies for messing up their missions such as harshly calling out Spinel for losing the pendant. Like Spinel, she regards Amethio as a liability.
